name: foundation-engine
description: Foundation Engine: a genre-neutral TypeScript and Three.js engine for browser games.

scripts.lint: npm run --silent lint:layers && npm run --silent lint:arch && npm run --silent lint:css && npm run --silent lint:generic && npm run --silent lint:brief && npm run --silent lint:budgets
scripts.test:ui-browser: node scripts/generate.mjs && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/hud-check.mjs playtest/ui/hud && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/action-hints-check.mjs playtest/ui/action-hints && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/compact-shell-check.mjs playtest/ui/compact-shell && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/touch-sources-check.mjs playtest/ui/touch-sources && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/comfort-check.mjs playtest/ui/comfort && GAME_DIR=templates/arcade/game node scripts/generate.mjs && GAME_DIR=templates/arcade/game node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/native-controls-check.mjs playtest/ui/native-controls
scripts.test:diagnostics-browser: node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/event-trace-check.mjs playtest/diagnostics/event-trace && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/terrain-inspect-check.mjs playtest/diagnostics/terrain-inspect && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/entity-inspect-check.mjs playtest/diagnostics/entity-inspect && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/system-timing-check.mjs playtest/diagnostics/system-timing && node scripts/generate.mjs && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/session-recorder-check.mjs playtest/diagnostics/session-recorder --minutes 0.5
scripts.test:capture-browser: GAME_DIR=templates/blank/game node scripts/generate.mjs && GAME_DIR=templates/blank/game node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/capture-matrix-check.mjs playtest/ui/capture-matrix
scripts.test:framework-browser: node scripts/generate.mjs && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/terrain-worker-check.mjs playtest/framework/terrain-worker && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/terrain-regions-check.mjs playtest/framework/terrain-regions && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/model-inspect-check.mjs playtest/framework/model-inspect && node -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/route-dependencies-check.mjs playtest/framework/route-dependencies
scripts.test:replay-browser: GAME_DIR=templates/arcade/game node scripts/generate.mjs && GAME_DIR=templates/arcade/game node --import tsx -r ./scripts/silent-browser.cjs scripts/play/replay-check.mjs playtest/replay
